objective: Test whether the 5x3-k3 T2-O scalar map becomes exact when the frozen exact-rank GF(2)^2 decoder is extended from independent component values to all observed pairwise component-parity interactions.
frozen_from_prior: relative outcome code loss=00, draw=01, win=10

models.terms: rank-specific affine offset plus rank-specific linear component-parity terms
DEGREE1 plus rank-specific pair products x_C x_D for every component pair co-occurring in an observed T2-O parity signature

anti_circularity: Feature terms are generated only from frozen structural parity signatures and exact rank.
Outcome labels do not select which pair features exist.
Degree is fixed before the solve.
The degree-1 reproduction is a mechanical control.
falsifiers: Any DEGREE2 contradiction rejects quadratic sufficiency on this carrier.
A DEGREE2 pass establishes only finite existence of a quadratic decoder, not a unique or minimal interaction set.
next_if_pass: Test the same frozen degree-2 model class on the independent 4x4-k4 exact-rank affine-failure carrier, then minimize interactions.
next_if_fail: Extract the minimum degree-2 contradiction before considering cubic or non-polynomial finite algebra.
